# Senthil Nagappan

> Forward-Deployed AI Experience, AI Governance, and Human Systems Integration leader. Embedded with users, engineering, product, and risk teams to move regulated AI from ambiguity to production. 18+ years in regulated healthcare, federal, defense, financial-services, and retail environments; 7+ years leading compliance, risk, and advisory programs with client-facing delivery. Based in Frisco, TX (US).

Multi-page portfolio (React SPA with real routes). Primary operating model: forward-deployed delivery through field immersion, problem framing, production-fidelity prototyping, live deployment, and continuous validation. Core themes: NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, EU AI Act readiness, human oversight and override design, explainability and disclosure UX, WCAG 2.2 AAA accessibility, human factors engineering (IEC 62366, MIL-STD-1472H).

## Key pages

- [Home](https://web-halo-shine.lovable.app/): Forward-deployed positioning, selected work, AI governance overview, expertise, operating model, credentials.
- [AI Governance case study](https://web-halo-shine.lovable.app/ai-governance): "Designing the Last Mile of AI Governance" — NIST AI RMF operating loop, control library, ISO 42001 / NIST / EU AI Act crosswalk, AI inventory & registry schema, third-party and shadow-AI risk, AI literacy tiers, incident taxonomy, US state patchwork, agentic-AI autonomy tiers, GRC tooling.
- [Framework crosswalk essay](https://web-halo-shine.lovable.app/writing/ai-control-crosswalk): Long-form published article on mapping one internal control set to ISO/IEC 42001, NIST AI RMF, and the EU AI Act.
- [In-House AI Product Lab](https://web-halo-shine.lovable.app/lab): Self-initiated AI product concepts (clearly labeled as concepts, not client work).
- [Design systems & brand](https://web-halo-shine.lovable.app/brand): Design tokens, shared components, brand-consistent UI at scale.
